title: Painting Course
description:
You are starting to enter your world of Colour.
You will have 6wks of using different paints, pastels etc on canvases and different surfaces.

You dont have to be the best at painting.. The whole point is taking part, leaving your stresses outside and just trying something new.

Painting is so therapeutic, so why not join us , I run a very warm welcoming lessons whether your on your own or you come with friends.
